pages.title: The Garden Forecast
pages.text: Plan your planting before the weather changes.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find the Calendar recipe in JEI. Read crop tooltips for their seasons; no season change is required.

pages.title: Choose a seasonal crop
pages.text: Read crop fertility seasons before planting. Crops without a seasonal entry are not automatically forbidden; slowing, prevention and death depend on settings.

pages.title: Read the farming calendar
pages.text: The Calendar shows early, middle and late season progress and days. Tropical biomes use their local cycle.

pages.title: Plan for seasonal weather
pages.text: Temperate and tropical biomes have different weather cycles. Temperature, foliage and rainfall change; summer crops follow their tropical fertility rules.
